## The decision this serves

Two sections, one control and one treated, cut from different regions. You are about to integrate them. Decide what the correction is going to remove.

**Scale.** Runs in 30 min, peak memory 16 GB.
Watch **integration strength, when sections differ in region** — that is what stops being safe on a full section.
:::

## Concept

Why two sections are never only technical replicates: depth, region and handling all differ, and region is often the thing being studied.

**The assumption that breaks first.** That batch and biology are separable in this design.

## Failure mode

**What it produces.** Integration succeeds by every standard metric and quietly removes the regional difference that was the finding.

**The diagnostic that catches it.** Plot the regional marker spatially before and after; the gradient is gone while the mixing metric improved.
